name: PopCorners Sea Salt Popped Corn Crisps
whyItWorks: The ultimate movie-night popcorn replacement! Made with non-GMO yellow corn, sunflower oil, and sea salt, air-popped under heat and pressure into crispy triangular crisps. Contains ZERO sharp hulls, ZERO unpopped kernels, and melts smoothly under saliva.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag during movie night or travel. Satisfies the crunchy popcorn craving without the risk of emergency bowel obstruction.
